Φ = 2π + K / (8π²) = 6.250028

A=20 uses the diagonal specialization Δ(t,t,t) = (t^½ − t^−½)³; the standard one-variable Alexander polynomial, (t − 1)⁴, gives 70. L_B = 60.194 is the proton mass run backwards, so matching m_p is not a test. 58.006 is the length of the presumed-minimal tight Borromean rings (Cantarella, Fu, Kusner, Sullivan & Wrinkle, 2006), so the ideal ropelength is at most 58.006, where the formula gives about 759 MeV (−19%). By its own pre-stated window (60.194 ± 0.3) the prediction is falsified at leading order, and ledger §2.15 is retracted to Conjecture (§2.92).
